notes: Replaces Thread.sleep(100) with awaitStatus(task, ScheduledTask.TaskStatus.COMPLETED, 5000), a new helper that sleeps 20 ms per pass in a loop that rechecks the task status on every pass, is bounded by a deadline, and leaves silently when the deadline passes. The call is followed directly by assertEquals(ScheduledTask.TaskStatus.COMPLETED, task.getStatus()), an assertion of the same condition. ADR 0007 Decision 7 judges a hand written poll loop that leaves silently as a condition wait when every call of it is followed directly by an assertion of the same condition, as a latch's boolean is asserted, so the sleep is a poll interval and the patch is accepted. The bound is 5000 ms.
